City of Chicago
                                                                    O2023-987
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 2/1/2023
Sponsor(s):                   Ervin (28)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 2-1 at 2901-2943 W
                              Harrison St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all ofthe Cl-2,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on IVIap No. 2-1 in
the area bound by:

      West Harrison Street; South Francisco Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel West
      Harrison Street; and a line 148.5 feet east of and parallel to South Sacramento Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         Jason C. Ervin
                                                         Alderman, 28*" Ward




Common Address:
2901-2943 W. Harrison Street
